name: Concat
description: Edits video locally with captions, keyframes, effects, and 4K export for creators, and lets AI agents cut, caption, and export projects via its built-in MCP server.

skills.name: Projects and Media
skills.description: Creates, opens, saves, and closes projects, and probes and imports media.

skills.name: Timeline Editing
skills.description: Adds, trims, splits, moves, and re-speeds clips, with masks and stabilization, as undoable edit commands.

skills.name: Titles and Captions
skills.description: Adds titles with per-word styling and adds captions to the timeline.

skills.name: Keyframes and Effects
skills.description: Sets and clears keyframes, applies effect layers, and instantiates templates.

skills.name: Export and Frame Preview
skills.description: Runs exports with progress and returns the composited frame as an image so the agent can look at its work.
